brief:
Middle East Eye reported that Maryam Youssef, a young Gaza physician, volunteered at Nasser Hospital during Israeli bombardment operations. Youssef discussed her experience working in the facility while contending with casualties, displacement, and disease outbreaks across the territory.

The doctor's account documented conditions at one of Gaza's major medical centers as the conflict continued. Her testimony detailed the health crisis unfolding amid ongoing military operations in the enclave.

title: Gaza doctor describes hospital work amid Israeli bombardment
